provenance: designed private restoration story instances; original server partition semantics unknown
identity: persistent unique(kind, role_id, original newbie origin.chapter_id); record account, creation_id, origin policy/route fingerprint, exact source task and this directory policy; current login epoch authorizes access but is not identity
allocation: random62bits OR 2**62, actual database uniqueness, up to8 collision retries; same story key returns the existing exact address; mismatch rejects without replacement
public_instances: legacy public map template IDs remain outside this private namespace; a private ID is never used as a resource template ID
authorization: trusted task caller verifies actual completed origin and exact original route/source task under current role lease; directory checks persistent owner and immutable intent; native request cannot allocate by specifying a key or instance
allocation_transaction: startup DDL only; allocation joins an already-open role caller transaction, no own connection or commit; rollback leaves no allocation; an earlier durable allocation may remain empty and never means role entry or task completion
entry_transaction: exact-source adoption, committed target handoff, role position and instance binding, task completion/next state and stable receipt share one role transaction; directory row alone grants no membership
recovery: recover the durable handoff first, then current exact instance checkpoint and matching directory; cold load reuses its original full address; missing/mismatched private identity rejects instead of public fallback or reallocation
capacity_behavior: reject new load/reservation locally when full; leave other owners running and current source authoritative; capacity is a designed budget, not tested commercial throughput
unload_conditions: no member, reservation, frozen source, queued handoff or unacknowledged scene delivery; remove only runtime projection after owner confirmation; retain persistent directory identity and existing receipts
cold_state: initial supported dream has static original actors only; dynamic mutations require their own durable actor checkpoint before cold reconstruction; unavailable checkpoint refuses rather than restoring removed actors
wire_scene: send original scene template1501 using existing verified codec; full MapAddress is server routing identity; high bits of native scene q64 are not a proven instance encoding
activation: decision and isolated domain implementation authorized; shared full-address routing, fixed release and GUI not yet validated
